entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Plane of inventors where aether powers industry.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: The energy of Kaladesh that powers its artifacts and which gremlins feed on.

entities.name: Gremlins
entities.description: Non-sapient six-limbed creatures that feed on aether by dismantling artifacts.

entities.name: Aetherborn
entities.description: Short-lived byproducts of aether refinement who love art and collecting.
